purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

expected_behavior: Identify the perimeter mismatch at the claim level.

input.scenario: A hypothetical PDF has a reporting period but no verifiable publication date.

expected_behavior: Quarantine cutoff-sensitive uses pending contemporaneous evidence.

cases.expected_response_excerpt: Mark publication timing unresolved. Quarantine cutoff-sensitive uses pending contemporaneous evidence. Avoid inferring publication date from the reporting period.
